findings.detail: Cross-seed predictions are NOT identical. Stage after_00 has 54/180 divergent cases (70.0% overlap); Stage after_01 has 75/180 divergent cases (58.3% overlap); Stage after_02 has 23/180 divergent cases (87.2% overlap). Training losses and seed receipts confirm proper independent seed initialization.
findings.convergence_cause: The identical 4/180 accuracy at stage after_02 is caused by behavioral convergence to empty string generation ('') under unguided raw prompting, not by seed leakage.

findings.detail: 137 / 180 cases (76.1%) generate empty string ('') due to immediate EOS token emission. 31 / 180 cases generate raw numeric digits ('8', '4', '6', '56') learned from NWP training data.
findings.root_cause: Prompt in run_m0_fc40.py was fed as raw string directly into tokenizer(record.prompt) without Qwen ChatML apply_chat_template, causing the Instruct model to treat it as raw text continuation rather than answering a multiple-choice question.

findings.detail: eval_mcqa.jsonl labels are lowercase ('a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'Yes', 'No'). parse_strict_mcqa_answer in tempun_dataset.py strictly matches uppercase ('A', 'B', 'C', 'D') and regex ^[A-D]. Any lowercase prediction returns None (INVALID). Even if uppercase were returned, 'A' == 'a' evaluates to False.
findings.mathematical_impossibility: Under tempun_dataset.py parser, all 156 4-choice questions were mathematically impossible to be counted as correct.

findings.detail: All 4 correct cases (and all 12 valid cases) belong exclusively to the 24 Yes/No questions (specifically in year:1984 where the model happened to emit '. No' which matched gold target 'No'). Exactly 0 out of 156 4-choice questions were parsed as valid.

Partner's historical anchor (Ticktack v2, 20.51% Strict Acc, 26.85% Invalid) and F0 baseline (20.93% Strict Acc, 38.89% Invalid) were strictly evaluated using ChatML apply_chat_template (system prompt + 'Answer directly with only the option letter (a, b, c, d) or Yes/No') and case-insensitive regex parsing returning lowercase. Comparing M0-FC40 raw-prompt eval against partner chat-prompt eval violates Paired Evaluation Protocol.

required_remedy_actions: REMEDY_1: Fix tempun_dataset.py parse_strict_mcqa_answer to support case-insensitive regex matching for options [a-d] returning lowercase, perfectly aligned with eval_mcqa.jsonl gold targets.
REMEDY_2: Align generative evaluation in run_m0_fc40.py to use Qwen ChatML apply_chat_template with the exact prompt instruction used in TICKTACK_V2_CONTINUAL_EVAL.
REMEDY_3: Re-evaluate M0-FC40 checkpoints under unified ChatML + case-insensitive contract to measure true continual alignment performance before drawing conclusions about Alignment Tax.
